preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the array in each query is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all n over all queries does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all queries does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains the number of stack exterminable subarrays for each query.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
invariants.description: Each element in the array is within the bounds set by n.
